summary: Iter 22 additions fully verified. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (wallet CSV export headers/body/summary rows, PDF magic bytes+content-disposition, /wallet/withdrawals type+sign, 401 unauth, regression on /wallet + /wallet/referral-stats). Frontend (mobile 390x844): (A) Worker attendance shows request-leave-link card 'Leave Requests', taps to /leave, prior testIDs (today-status, job-self, checkin-button) intact. (B) Worker wallet: wallet-export-csv & wallet-export-pdf visible pills next to Transactions heading; CSV download filename correct, first line == expected header; PDF download filename ends .pdf and content starts b'%PDF-'; withdrawal row shows amber 'Processing' pill with italic description 'Bank transfer usually completes in 24 hours.' both before and after issuing a fresh ₹5 withdrawal to test@upi. (C) Client, (D) Contractor, (E) Admin (via /admin/attendance) all show leave-inbox-link card 'Leave Inbox', tap navigates to /leave and 'Inbox' chip is selected/visible. No blocking issues found. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.tsx WalletExportBar swallows download errors silently (catch {}); consider surfacing a toast when export fails so users know to retry.

wallet_export_csv writes header line then iterates rows before writing an empty separator + TOTAL CREDIT/DEBIT/NET rows; if a user's txn 'note' field contains commas/quotes it will still be quoted by csv.writer (fine), but consider trimming or escaping upi_id column for safety.
server.py continues to grow (>2800 lines) — file-size threshold repeatedly flagged; iter 22 added ~200 more lines. Suggest splitting wallet + export routers into wallet_router.py.
seed_data_creation: During frontend test a real ₹5 withdrawal to test@upi was submitted for worker 9000000002 (used to force a fresh 'processing' status row); also topped up ₹100 during backend pytest to guarantee non-zero balance for withdrawal. No other seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 22 (wallet CSV/PDF export, /wallet/withdrawals endpoint, attendance→leave discoverability cards) is fully verified backend+frontend. If retest needed, run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_iter22.py -v`. Frontend flows use testIDs: request-leave-link, leave-inbox-link, wallet-export-csv, wallet-export-pdf, action-withdraw, withdraw-amount/upi/submit. Admin uses /admin/attendance (not /attendance) — that route hosts leave-inbox-link. Worker route /attendance hosts request-leave-link. Withdrawal status pill/description logic is in wallet.tsx `txnStatusInfo`.
